# Velloxa Agency

> Velloxa (https://velloxa.website) is an elite AI integration and web engineering agency. We architect custom multi-agent LLM systems, sub-second Next.js web applications, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) growth engines for ambitious businesses.

Velloxa bridges the gap between frontier artificial intelligence workflows and production-grade web systems to eliminate operational bottlenecks and scale client revenue.

## Core Capabilities

- [AI Integration](https://velloxa.website/#ai-integration): Autonomous multi-agent workflows, custom LLM agents, 24/7 lead intake qualification, and internal RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge engines.
- [Web Engineering](https://velloxa.website/#web-engineering): High-performance, mobile-first web platforms built on Next.js 14, React, and Tailwind CSS with sub-800ms Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- [Passion Marketing & GEO](https://velloxa.website/#passion-marketing): High-tier SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO for Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini), conversion rate optimization (CRO), and organic reach.
- [Competitive Benchmarks](https://velloxa.website/#comparison): Structured performance and SLA comparison versus traditional agencies.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://velloxa.website/#faq): Direct answers to common questions about our technical architecture, timeline, pricing, and onboarding.

## Key Benchmarks & SLA

- Core Web Vitals LCP: < 0.8s
- Weekly Hours Saved per Department: 40+ hours
- Traffic Growth: 2X - 3X organic visibility
- Uptime & Monitoring: 99.9% autonomous availability
- Sprint Velocity: 1 - 3 week rapid production deployments
